mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-on-week improvement in WORKPLACES mobility (t-3w to t-0w: -62.4 to -60.4) signals resumption of commuting. This restores weekday foot traffic patterns and incidental retail visits, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 2.0 points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over next 28 days does not exceed mean over prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses by more than 5 points in week t+1.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has stabilized near -64% (t-1w: -66.0, t-0w: -63.9), indicating outdoor activity constraints remain binding. Consumers substitute toward enclosed retail venues as parks remain unattractive, increasing RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -60 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -50 within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC does not increase relative to prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has recovered from -70.1 (t-2w) to -64.7 (t-0w), a 5.4-point improvement. This restoration of public transport access enables retail-bound trips, particularly for non-grocery shopping, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 4 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 3.2 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT reverses by more than 3 points in t+1w, or RETAIL_REC does not rise in the first two weeks of the forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has stabilized at -20.7 (t-1w and t-0w), indicating essential-goods restrictions are no longer tightening. Concurrent stabilization of RETAIL_REC at -63.9 suggests policy constraints on non-essential retail are also plateauing, creating conditions for relaxation and recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM stabilizes within 2 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both series flat from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM declines by more than 3 points in t+1w, or RETAIL_REC does not improve by at least 3 points over the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 41.1 (t-2w) to 38.7 (t-0w), indicating consumers are spending less time at home. This behavioral shift toward out-of-home activity directly increases RETAIL_REC visits over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 40 for one week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 2.4 points from t-2w to t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 41 in t+1w, or RETAIL_REC does not increase within the first week of the forecast period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent improvement in both WORKPLACES (-60.4 at t-0w) and TRANSIT (-64.7 at t-0w) creates a synergistic effect: restored commuting + restored transit access = higher retail accessibility and foot traffic. RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks only when both proxies improve together.
candidate_trigger: both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve by at least 2 points in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 2.0 points and TRANSIT improved 3.2 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: Either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT reverses by more than 3 points in t+1w, or RETAIL_REC does not exceed prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has improved 2.4 points from t-3w (-66.3) to t-0w (-63.9), establishing a consistent upward trend. Extrapolation of this linear recovery trajectory predicts continued improvement over the next four weeks, independent of external shocks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 2.4 points over four weeks at average rate of 0.6 points per week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines by more than 2 points in any single week of the forecast period, or the four-week mean does not exceed the prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS remains severely depressed at -63.9 (t-0w) while RETAIL_REC is only -63.9, indicating consumers have not substituted toward outdoor recreation. If PARKS remains below -55 for the next two weeks, consumers will continue substituting toward enclosed retail venues, preventing RETAIL_REC from declining further and enabling modest recovery.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -55 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -50 within two weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines by more than 3 points in the first two weeks of the forecast period.
